note: Changes made by Chicago ordinance SO2026-0024930. Section numbers and headings come from the signed ordinance. Scope lines are our own short paraphrases, not code text. This file lists what the ordinance changes, not the whole code, and it contains no ICC model code text. No running code reads this file yet. See docs/chicago-2026-code.md.

field_notes.pdf_page: Page of the signed PDF. Printed page numbers are one lower.
field_notes.effective: Date under the ordinance's Article VI only. on_approval means upon passage and approval. Code Memorandum 2026-001 (not read directly, chicago.gov returned 403) describes optional use from 2026-10-01 and mandatory use from 2026-12-01. That has not been reconciled with these dates.
field_notes.mandatory_from: Date the ordinance's own transitional provisions (14A-1-105.7 to 105.9) require this code for new applications, with exceptions for earlier applications, minor revisions and later phases.
field_notes.markup_checked: True when underlines and strikethroughs were read by eye on the page image. False when the scope comes from OCR text, which loses that markup, so what was added versus removed should be rechecked before relying on the detail.

entries.title: 2026 Mechanical Code
entries.scope: Replaces the 2019 Interim Mechanical Code in full, with chapters 14M-1 to 14M-15.

entries.title: Adoption of the International Mechanical Code by reference
entries.scope: Adopts the 2024 IMC, excluding appendices, with Chicago's changes controlling where they conflict.

entries.title: Citations
entries.scope: Sets the citation form for adopted model provisions: title, IMC chapter, then IMC section.

entries.title: Global modifications
entries.scope: Swaps model code cross-references for the matching Chicago codes throughout the title.

entries.title: 2026 Fuel Gas Code
entries.scope: Replaces Title 14G in full, with chapters 14G-1 to 14G-9.

entries.title: Adoption of the International Fuel Gas Code by reference
entries.scope: Adopts the 2024 IFGC by reference, with Chicago's changes.

entries.title: Citations
entries.scope: Sets the citation form: title, IFGC chapter, then IFGC section.

entries.title: Former mechanical chapter
entries.scope: Chapter is repealed in full. Prior-code applications may still cite it under the transitional rules.

entries.title: Chapter 18-36
entries.scope: Chapter is repealed in full. The ordinance does not state its subject at this point, and we did not confirm it.

entries.title: 2026 Energy Transformation Code
entries.scope: Replaces Title 14N in full, split into commercial chapters 14N-C1 to C7 and residential chapters 14N-R1 to R8.

entries.title: Adoption of the IECC commercial provisions by reference
entries.scope: Adopts the 2024 IECC commercial provisions, excluding appendices, with Chicago's changes.

entries.title: Citations
entries.scope: Sets the commercial citation form, using a C prefix on the chapter.

entries.title: Adoption of the IECC residential provisions by reference
entries.scope: Adopts the 2024 IECC residential provisions, including appendix RF, with Chicago's changes.

entries.title: Citations
entries.scope: Sets the residential citation form, using an R prefix on the chapter, and treats appendices as a new Chapter 8.

entries.title: 2026 Interim Fire Prevention Code
entries.scope: Renames the title. Replaces chapters 14F-2, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 31 and 33, amends 14F-13, and adds 14F-80.

entries.title: Partial adoption of the International Fire Code by reference
entries.scope: Moves the partly adopted IFC from the 2018 to the 2024 edition.

entries.title: Notice
entries.scope: Says what counts as sufficient notice to owners, condominium associations, applicants and permit holders.

entries.title: Fuel gas (Title 14G)
entries.scope: Requires the 2026 Fuel Gas Code for permit applications from December 1, 2026, with the exceptions in 14A-1-105.8.1 to 8.3.

entries.title: Mechanical (Title 14M)
entries.scope: Requires the 2026 Mechanical Code from December 1, 2026. New subsections 8.1 to 8.3 cover earlier applications, minor revisions and later phases.

entries.title: Energy (Title 14N)
entries.scope: Requires the 2026 Energy Transformation Code from December 1, 2026. New subsections 9.7 to 9.9 cover earlier applications, minor revisions and later phases.

entries.title: Relocation of residents
entries.scope: Lets the building official order an owner to house residents displaced when a building is ordered vacated.

entries.title: General (work not requiring a permit)
entries.scope: Adjusts the no-permit list, including items for public way structures, portable ventilation equipment and portable fuel cells.

entries.title: Technical information
entries.scope: Covers technical opinions, reports and tests the building or fire code official may require with an application, including cost and preparer rules.

entries.title: Format and required information
entries.scope: Revises construction document format rules and who may seal them.

entries.title: Energy conservation
entries.scope: Revises the energy details construction documents must show.

entries.title: Mechanical information
entries.scope: Lists mechanical information construction documents must show, such as ventilation schedules, equipment capacities, duct and refrigeration layouts, and fuel gas piping.

entries.title: Disabled veterans
entries.scope: Waives permit fees for disability-related improvements to a disabled veteran's residence.

entries.title: Technical information
entries.scope: Lets officials require technical opinions or reports to check work done under a permit.

entries.title: Definitions
entries.scope: Article IV revises definitions including fire area, gypsum products, natural ventilation, occupiable space and yard. Article V adds interlocking interior exit stairway group, effective October 1.

entries.title: Building area
entries.scope: Explains the sprinkler factor in the Chicago building area equation.

entries.title: Incidental uses
entries.scope: Updates table entries for refrigeration machinery rooms and for stationary storage battery or fuel cell systems.

entries.title: Fire walls
entries.scope: Revises the limits on vertical shafts passing through the offset of a fire wall.

entries.title: Ducts and air transfer openings
entries.scope: Rewrites corridor fire damper exceptions and corridor ceiling rules.

entries.title: Fire alarm and detection systems
entries.scope: Revises manual fire alarm box exceptions, high-rise alarm requirements and presignal rules.

entries.title: Fire pumps
entries.scope: Adds a rule for marking fire pump piping.

entries.title: Carbon monoxide detection
entries.scope: Requires carbon monoxide detectors in certain new buildings to connect to the fire alarm system.

entries.title: Corridors
entries.scope: Revises corridor air movement rules, now pointing to the Mechanical Code, and the use of corridors for makeup air.

entries.title: Ventilation
entries.scope: Rewrites when spaces need mechanical exhaust, mechanical ventilation or natural ventilation, with an exception to natural ventilation for fully sprinklered buildings of 11 or more units that have mechanical ventilation throughout.

entries.title: Interior roof edge for shafts and fully enclosed courts
entries.scope: Adjusts protection options for roof edges and skylights at shafts and enclosed courts.

entries.title: Foam plastic insulation
entries.scope: Changes the handling of a foam plastic subsection, 2603.4.1.6. Read the marked PDF for the direction of the change.

entries.title: IBC Section 3313 Fire pump
entries.scope: Revises the Chicago replacement text on fire pumps during construction of tall buildings.

entries.title: High-rise buildings
entries.scope: Revises exit stairway separation in tall buildings and adds 403.5.7 on interlocking stair groups, covering shaft ratings and two-way communication.

entries.title: General (fire-resistance by construction type)
entries.scope: Extends a reduced roof rating footnote for certain residential buildings from four to five stories.

entries.title: Exterior walls
entries.scope: Extends several exterior wall and opening provisions for residential buildings from four to five stories.

entries.title: Number of exits and exit access doorways
entries.scope: Raises a Table 1006.2.1 footnote value from 20 to 32 for fully sprinklered buildings, with a limit for some Group R spaces.

entries.title: Exit and exit access doorway configuration
entries.scope: Widens a separation exception from Group R-2 to Group R. Lets an interlocking stair group count as two exits in sprinklered Group R stories up to 160 feet and 15 stories. Other cases need both officials' approval.

entries.title: Stairways
entries.scope: Article IV points permanent ladders to the Mechanical Code. Article V revises the narrower stair width exception so it does not apply to interlocking stair groups (Article V part checked by eye).

entries.title: Handrails
entries.scope: Widens exception 1 to 1014.6 by changing its wording from within to within or serving.

entries.title: Interior exit stairways and ramps
entries.scope: Revises stair designation, with letter pairs for interlocking stair groups.

entries.title: Exterior exit stairways and ramps
entries.scope: Extends two exceptions for Group R-2, R-3 and R-5 from four to five stories, on separation distance for combustible stairs and porches and on separation from the building interior.

entries.title: Exit discharge
entries.scope: Rewrites the egress court rules on width, height and wall protection, extending some allowances to Group R-2 buildings up to five stories.

entries.title: Table 14A-12-1204.3(4), Scope of Review Factor for Rehabilitation
entries.scope: Changes scope-of-review factor table entries for changes of occupancy.

entries.title: General definitions
entries.scope: Revises rehabilitation definitions, including reconfigured space and work area.

entries.title: Mechanical
entries.scope: Adds rules on repairing listed appliances and on changing refrigerants.

entries.title: Fire protection
entries.scope: Revises an exception for buildings without enough municipal water supply for sprinklers.

entries.title: IEBC Chapter 10
entries.scope: Adjusts egress and height-and-area hazard categories for changes of occupancy to Group R-2 in sprinklered buildings.

entries.title: General (condition reports)
entries.scope: Says who may prepare condition reports for different building systems.

entries.title: Maintenance
entries.scope: Requires heating, cooling and mechanical systems to be maintained, and allows a condition report to check it.

entries.title: Terminology and measurements
entries.scope: Revises zoning definitions, including an allowance to omit wiring from conduit at outdoor EV-ready spaces, and shelter definitions.

entries.title: Plumbing code sections
entries.scope: Amends Article 5 and many sections of the plumbing chapter, including 18-29-604.2, 604.8 and 604.10.1.3, and adds 18-29-312.2.1. Not itemized here.
